newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Air says McAdoo quits as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Air says McAdoo quits as CEO.

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Friday that Robert McAdoo has resigned as chief executive officer and president of the company and as chairman of the board, although he will continue as a director.
The company's board named John Tague as CEO and president and chairman of the board.

Vanguard said Tague is currently chairman, president and chief executive officer of Air South Airlines Inc. He will continue his positions as chairman, president and chief executive officer of Air South.
Vanguard, which began service in December 1994, is a low-price, short- to medium-haul passenger airline providing scheduled jet services to 13 cities.
